description: This file is a shell script that automates the process of running database migrations for a PostgreSQL database, including setup steps such as database creation, schema migrations tracking, optional PostGIS extension enabling, and applying individual migration scripts from a designated directory.

methods.name: create_db_if_needed
methods.description: Checks if the target PostgreSQL database exists and creates it if it does not.

methods.name: apply_init_if_needed
methods.description: Ensures the schema_migrations tracking table exists, applying the initial migration if necessary.

methods.name: enable_postgis_if_requested
methods.description: Enables the PostGIS extension in the database if specified via environment variables.

methods.name: apply_migrations
methods.description: Applies all pending migration scripts from the migrations directory that have not been applied yet.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Coordinates the overall migration process by invoking setup and application functions sequentially.

calls: psql -h ${POSTGRES_HOST} -p ${POSTGRES_PORT} -U ${POSTGRES_USER} -d postgres -tAc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname='${POSTGRES_DB}'"
${PSQL} -c "INSERT INTO schema_migrations(version, checksum) VALUES ('0001_init.sql', NULL) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;"
${PSQL} -c "INSERT INTO schema_migrations(version, checksum) VALUES ('${base}', NULL) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;"
